Complete direct q=2 product-fiber enumeration and q=3 centralizer checks corroborate arithmetic, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The earlier natural existence problem first allows a nonzero product in size four. At precisely this threshold, the theorem computes every multiplicative factorization fiber over every finite field, including the zero exceptional stratum and characteristic two. The precise positive counts support arithmetic sampling and representation multiplicity questions; not merely a numerical sample or qualitative image restatement.
